headline: Southern New Hampshire and Bentley take maximum points
dek: Both have won their two conference matches, and no other programme has won more than one. Southern New Hampshire are also the only side yet to lose at all: unbeaten in eight, with twenty-nine goals scored and eight conceded.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's twenty-nine goals are spread across at least fifteen scorers, so no single player carries the tallest bar; Southern Connecticut, at the foot of the chart with eight, have drawn four of their six matches, so the shortest bar is not the worst record.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire are the last programme yet to lose after Saint Anselm ended Pace's unbeaten start.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern New Hampshire have won six matches and drawn two, and are the only programme without a defeat.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Cody Holbert has scored nine of Assumption's eighteen goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Michael's have lost five matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Joe Zweben has made forty-one saves, more than any other goalkeeper listed.

last_match.line: Southern New Hampshire remain the only programme yet to lose; Saint Anselm have still not drawn a match this season.

next_match.line: Pace have lost once all season and their goalkeeper has made more saves than any other listed; Southern New Hampshire have scored more goals than any other programme.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
